subject: FREE statement
notes: Format `FREE { data-name-1 } ...` (cite.py --check 14.9.15.2 "FREE" -> OK). Grammar `freeStatement : FREE dataReference+` = one-or-more operands; dataReference also admits qualification/subscripting, which only reaches a data-pointer inside a STRONG typedef (13.18.60.3 SR14 --check OK confines USAGE POINTER to level 1 or STRONG-typedef subordinates) - the pointer then has to be referenced that way, so this is not a leniency beyond reference-format rules. Probes (pinned cobol.exe, probe/free): f1 `FREE P Q N P` parses and runs; f3 --std 85 -> COBOL0900 'FREE requires COBOL-2002'; --std 2002 compiles and runs. Existing goldens conformance:cases/14.9.3-ALLOCATE/pointer_alloc and allocate_initialized exercise only single-operand FREE, so no spec-derived test covers the repeated-operand shape -> test-ref empty. [code-location note: edition gate] || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (FREE is absent from ISO 1989:1985; the 2023 Annex E records only 2014->2023 changes, and 14.9.15 is unchanged text in 2014/2023)
